articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Slip As Traders Brace For CPI. The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Tuesday, Jan, 13 2026 US stock futures are slightly softer this morning, with key contracts on the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 pointing to a modest dip as investors sit tight ahead of fresh inflation figures. The market is bracing for US consumer prices to hold around 2.7% year on year in December, with core inflation also at 2.7% and monthly gains of 0.3% for both headline and core.
